visualDirection.line: clean delicate line art, thin-to-medium contour, minimal heavy black
visualDirection.rendering: refined cel shading with soft gradient transitions
visualDirection.lighting: soft atmospheric fill, strong rim-light during soul-power moments
visualDirection.effects: ribbon-shaped energy trails, particles, thin bloom, speed streaks, no static aura halos
visualDirection.actionComposition: diagonal panels, low camera, foreground crop, weapon/hand breaking frame
visualDirection.quietComposition: close-ups, breathing room, gentle light, fewer effects

global: Keep each character's hair silhouette identical across all panels.
Keep academy outfit colors and trim unchanged within the chapter.
Use the same eye shape and iris design per character.
Do not add random armor, capes, jewelry, tattoos or fantasy accessories.
No chibi proportions except tiny comedic reaction panel if explicitly requested.

lamMac.build: slim, compact, slightly shorter than Tang Wulin
lamMac.hair: black with cool blue sheen, layered fringe, restrained silhouette
lamMac.eyesActive: silver iris with very thin concentric rings, subtle cyan glint
lamMac.outfit: simple Eastsea Academy student outfit, dark-blue and white, no special cape
lamMac.bodyLanguage: quiet, economical movements, observant, rarely exaggerated
lamMac.soulEffect: thin silver-cyan trajectory lines, transparent overlays, no giant eye floating behind him

tangWulin.role: canonical lead remains visually and narratively central
tangWulin.energy: deep internal gold, dragon pressure implied before fully shown
tangWulin.rule: do not make him look older, villainous, or over-armored

xieXie.energy: light/dark twin-dragon suggestion only when viewed through Heavenly Eye

wuChangkong.hair: long blue hair, clean flowing strands
wuChangkong.presence: temperature drop implied by color and stillness, not excessive aura

cameraRules.dialogue: 35-70mm equivalent, eye-level or subtle three-quarter angle
cameraRules.action: 18-35mm equivalent, dynamic foreshortening, slight dutch tilt permitted
cameraRules.mystery: tight eye close-up, shallow depth of field, negative space
cameraRules.impact: one dominant focal action per panel; avoid clutter

negativePrompt: photorealistic, 3D render, western superhero comic, thick black outlines, chibi, flat coloring, muddy colors, excessive armor, generic isekai costume, plastic skin, malformed hands, extra fingers, duplicated limbs, inconsistent hairstyle, inconsistent outfit, unreadable text, random symbols, overexposed aura, floating UI HUD
